doc: What one reply-route round trip means, from the provider's message envelope {content, refusal, finish_reason} (each may be absent or null) to either the parsed result or one fixed failure. The payload rules are reply_parse.json's. On top: (1) a non-blank refusal, or finish_reason 'content_filter' with blank content, is the failure 'refused' and nothing else is looked at; (2) blank or null content is 'no_json'; (3) the replies are exactly the usable ones the model gave: fewer than three stay fewer, nothing is padded, copied or invented to reach three; (4) 'analysis' is read-only commentary and is never a candidate: a payload with analysis but no usable replies fails with 'no_replies'; (5) every failure is class invalid_response (retry_policy.json) with fixed text that carries nothing of the model's output.
